blurb: Old Brockway Golf Course offers over 3400 yards of golf with two par 5’s, two par 3’s and five par 4’s, featuring small turtle-back greens and tight fairways. The course is family owned and operated for over 30 years and is rated as one of the top 9 hole courses in the country by Golf Channel. Guests can enjoy walking through towering Jeffery pines with lake views on every hole.
